candidate_relations.label: Dengue fever due to DENV-4
candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record confirms DENV-4 infection by RT-PCR and positive NS1, so 'Dengue fever due to DENV-4' is accurate as the parent/etiologic diagnosis. However, the benchmark reference is specifically 'Dengue myocarditis', which requires recognition of the cardiac complication evidenced by elevated troponin I (peaked 1.6 μg/L), elevated pro-BNP (1913 ng/L), ECG changes (inverted T waves in inferior leads), and bibasal crackles/pulmonary oedema. C001 names only the parent infectious entity without the myocarditis component.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Identifies the dengue infection and serotype but omits the myocarditis complication that is the specific final diagnostic object requested

case_quality_flags: Cardiac biomarkers (troponin, pro-BNP) and ECG findings strongly support myocarditis as the specific complication; the reference diagnosis appropriately specifies this over generic dengue fever
